![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14063571/assets/c0745df4ba2b63cb0479743f03df384c1fd70d74851b9feaecdb88b62618220e.png)

Evaluate the triple integral 
${∭}_{R}12xz\,dV$
over the region $R,$ shown above.

*Hint: All surfaces, except for the right one, are parallel to the corresponding coordinate planes.*
worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14063571/assets/c1853c772e219f53a0b394bd0b50beea6b33c451afc453983cdccb1df333c5ea.png)

 

Notice that our solid can be written as the type III region

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,(x,z)\in D,\,\,0\le y\le 4-x-z},
$$

where

$$
D={(x,z)\,:\,0\le x\le 1,\,\,0\le z\le 2}
$$

is the projection of $R$ onto the $xz$-plane, shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14063571/assets/0620f8f25174cb71528049341669458c68a7ccfdd3ff76b5f62c878307080419.png)

Hence, the type III representation of $R$ is

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,0\le x\le 1,\,\,0\le z\le 2,\,\,0\le y\le 4-x-z}
$$

As a result, by writing down our triple integral as a repeated integral, we obtain

$$
{∭}_{R}12xz\,\text{d}V={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{4-x-z}12xz\,dy\,dz\,dx.
$$

First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $y$, treating $x$ and $z$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{4-x-z}12xz\,dy\,dz\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}[{\int }_{0}^{4-x-z}12xz\,dy]dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}12xz[y]_{y=0}^{y=4-x-z}\,dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}12xz(4-x-z)\,dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}(48xz-12{x}^{2}z-12x{z}^{2})\,dz\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $z$, treating $x$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}(48xz-12{x}^{2}z-12x{z}^{2})\,dz\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{2}(48xz-12{x}^{2}z-12x{z}^{2})\,dz]dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[24x{z}^{2}-6{x}^{2}{z}^{2}-4x{z}^{3}]_{z=0}^{z=2}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(64x-24{x}^{2})\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}(64x-24{x}^{2})\,dx & ={[32{x}^{2}-8{x}^{3}]}_{x=0}^{x=1} \\  & =(32-8)-0 \\  & =24.\end{aligned}
$$
